integrity: The lower bound is exact because, for any two distinct noncentral vertices, only those two vertices can distinguish their two spokes. The upper bound is proved by checking an arbitrary adjacent-edge pair for the set of all noncentral vertices except one, including the sole case in which the two noncommon endpoints are the center and the omitted vertex. Equality then forces the complete basis classification. A standalone checker independently evaluates the definition on finite parameter ranges.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to generalized windmills with at least two complete blades and blade size at least two.
The one-blade complete-graph case is excluded.
Dutch windmills with cycle blades, noncomplete blade graphs, and arbitrary vertex-amalgamations are not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification is corroborative only; the general theorem follows from the proof.
The 2022 wheel-related article was available only through indexed text and abstract-level material during comparison, leaving a small residual terminology risk.
title: Local edge metric bases of generalized windmill graphs
